title.original: TokenDance: Scaling Multi-Agent LLM Serving via Collective KV Cache Sharing
title.zh: TokenDance：通过集体式 KV 缓存共享扩展多智能体 LLM 服务
title.en: TokenDance: Scaling Multi-Agent LLM Serving via Collective KV Cache Sharing

inclusion_reason.zh: TokenDance 将多 Agent 的轮次通信结构转化为集体 KV 复用和差分存储机制，属于面向 Agent 负载的服务基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: TokenDance turns round-based multi-agent communication into collective KV reuse and differential storage, making it serving infrastructure for agent workloads.

abstract.zh: TokenDance 利用同步多 Agent 应用中的 All-Gather 模式，让一轮内所有 Agent 集体复用共享输出对应的 KV 缓存。它以主副本加块稀疏差分表示兄弟缓存，降低重复存储并扩大可并发 Agent 数。
abstract.en: TokenDance exploits the All-Gather structure of round-synchronous multi-agent applications so every agent collectively reuses KV state for shared outputs. Sibling caches are represented as block-sparse differences from one master copy, reducing duplication and expanding concurrency.

problem.zh: 同步轮次会把相同的 Agent 输出块复制进每个参与者提示，现有逐请求前缀复用仍重复保存和处理大量相同 KV 状态。
problem.en: Synchronized rounds copy the same agent-output blocks into every participant prompt, while request-local prefix reuse still stores and processes much of that KV state repeatedly.

approach.zh: KV Collector 每轮只执行一次集体缓存复用，使共享块成本不随 Agent 数增长；Diff-Aware Storage 仅为每个兄弟上下文保存相对主缓存的差分。
approach.en: KV Collector performs one collective reuse operation per round, making shared-block cost independent of agent count, while Diff-Aware Storage records only each sibling context's delta from a master cache.

system_design.zh: TokenDance 在中央轮次调度器旁维护共享块目录、主缓存和 Agent 差分；一轮输出汇总后，Collector 批量建立下一轮可复用映射，再交给推理引擎预填充。
system_design.en: Alongside the round scheduler, TokenDance maintains a shared-block directory, a master cache, and per-agent deltas. After gathering a round, the Collector builds reuse mappings in bulk before the next prefill phase.

key_results.zh: 在 GenerativeAgents 和 AgentSociety 上，论文报告更高并发 Agent 容量、显著的单 Agent KV 压缩及更快预填充。
key_results.en: On GenerativeAgents and AgentSociety, the paper reports greater concurrent-agent capacity, substantial per-agent KV reduction, and faster prefill.

limitations.zh: 优势建立在轮次同步和大量共享提示块之上；异步 Agent、个性化上下文占比高或频繁分支的工作流可能缺少足够差分复用。
limitations.en: The gains assume round synchronization and substantial shared prompt blocks; asynchronous agents, highly personalized context, or frequently branching workflows may expose far less reusable structure.

notes.zh: 两项工作负载、两类基线和四个摘要结果已录入；模型、GPU、Agent 数和 SLO 阈值待全文审计。
notes.en: Two workloads, two baseline classes, and four abstract results are recorded; models, GPUs, agent counts, and SLO thresholds await full-text audit.
